item: the deduced source topics are applied in chunks: the write window is held 1.6 s, not 27-30 s
summary: apply_source_topics read every candidate with session.get and flushed one UPDATE per changed source INSIDE the single-writer window: 86,470 sources (the field corpus's count, each given 3 topics) held it 26.7/28.9/27.5 s with 86,472 statements (29.9 s on the encrypted store), 17.7/18.6 s when there was nothing to add, and every other writer queued behind it once a day (scheduler tail) and on each Diagnostics enrich-sources call. It now reads (id, domain, tags, rss_url) and writes by primary key with executemany, SOURCE_TOPICS_CHUNK=900 sources per statement: 1.6 to 1.8 s with 195 statements (five runs, two encrypted), 0.37/0.40 s and 98 statements when idle, the same final state (hash over id, tags, feed_key of every row). The ORM path's one side effect, the Source before_update hook that re-derives feed_key from rss_url, is kept by writing feed_key(rss_url) in the same UPDATE (a stale value is healed exactly as before); no @validates, after_update, onupdate column or version column exists on Source and the three sources triggers fire on UPDATE OF domain,id only. R390 (coordinator), measured by st_measure.py in /mnt/project-files/keyword-lane/, proposal proposal-source-topics-bulk-apply-2026-10-28.md. 6 tests (statement count red on main), 5 mutants killed. 86,470 is the upper bound: a real run writes only the sources that qualify.
